lung_efron.call: coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex, data = lung_d, ties = 'efron')

lung_weighted_efron.call: coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex, data = lung_d, weights = w, robust = TRUE, ties = 'efron')

lung_breslow.call: coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex, data = lung_d, ties = 'breslow')

lung_weighted_breslow.call: coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex, data = lung_d, weights = w, robust = TRUE, ties = 'breslow')

lung_strata_sex_efron.call: coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + ph_ecog + strata(sex), data = lung_cc, ties = 'efron')

settings.missing: the one row with ph.ecog missing is dropped

ovarian_efron.call: coxph(Surv(futime, fustat) ~ age + ecog_ps, data = ovarian_d, ties = 'efron')

heart_efron.call: coxph(Surv(start, stop, event) ~ age + year + transplant, data = heart_d, ties = 'efron')
